subject: District Facilities Condition Assessment
overview: The School Committee received a facilities assessment identifying $83.7 million in needed repairs across five schools and heard the Interim Superintendent's formal entry findings report. The committee also approved a strategic planning outreach initiative and an updated concussion policy.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine business, including meeting minutes, a $7,500 sound equipment donation for the McGlynn school, and a $2,500 grant for nurse-provider communication.

items.title: Mustang Moment: Robotics 360
items.summary: Middle school students and staff presented the district's new Robotics 360 STEM initiative, which integrates coding, engineering, and collaborative problem-solving into the science challenge curriculum.

items.title: Facilities Condition Assessment Report
items.summary: Architect Kevin Provencher presented a comprehensive assessment of five schools, identifying $83.7 million in necessary repairs and lifecycle replacements over the next five years. The report highlighted critical needs for roof replacements and floor tile failures while noting that no immediate emergency safety hazards were found.

items.title: New Superintendent Induction Program
items.summary: Dr. Meg Mayo-Brown introduced the three-year professional induction and coaching framework designed to support the development of transformational leadership for the Interim Superintendent.

items.title: Transition Entry Findings Report
items.summary: Interim Superintendent Galusi reported findings from her first eight months, identifying needs for instructional consistency, diversified staffing, and improved facilities maintenance. The report grounded future strategic planning in the pillars of belonging, consistency, and coherence.

items.title: Strategic Planning Update
items.summary: Approved a community outreach plan including a public survey and focus groups to inform the district's next strategic plan and the search for a permanent superintendent.

items.title: Concussion Policy Second Reading
items.summary: Approved the second reading of updated Policy JJIF regarding concussion management, training requirements, and return-to-play protocols.

items.title: Shore Educational Collaborative and MASC Resolutions
items.summary: Received the quarterly Shore Educational Collaborative update and voted on resolutions for the upcoming Massachusetts Association of School Committees delegate assembly.
